biocontainers.summary: A causal reasoning tool for network identification (from gene expression data) using integer value programming

biotools.summary: An upgraded causal reasoning tool from Melas et al in R with updated assignments of TFs' weights from PROGENy scores. Optimization parameters can be freely adjusted and multiple solutions can be obtained and aggregated.
